verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak text block: the SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline, the CTA is shrunk to a pill no bigger than the badges, and the body copy is tiny and hard to read. A is worse because it pulls the layered graphic apart: the backdrop circle is stranded and cut off at the far left while the can floats bare on the right. B keeps the can on its circle as one intact unit.
